comment: f(y, b) <= y with b = bottom gives y a constructor at every path 0^t. For each modulus p in 2, 3, 5, 7 a cycle of upper bounds a_0, ..., a_{p-1} with a_i <= f(a_{i+1}, b) and a_{p-1} <= f(a_0, a_{p-1}), entered by x <= f(a_1, b), lets x have a constructor at 0^t 1 only when t + 1 is a multiple of p. Hence x <= y fails, but only at paths of length at least lcm(2, 3, 5, 7) = 210; the shortest hole is 0^209 1.
